name: Zendesk
desc: Customer service software and support ticket system

actions.name: create-ticket
actions.description: Create a new ticket in Zendesk.

actions.name: update-ticket
actions.description: Modify ticket fields or status via API call.

actions.name: add-tag-to-ticket
actions.description: Apply one or more tags to a ticket.

actions.name: remove-tag-from-ticket
actions.description: Remove one or more tags from a ticket.

actions.name: attach-file-to-ticket
actions.description: Attach a file to a ticket.

actions.name: add-comment-to-ticket
actions.description: Append a public/private comment to a ticket.

actions.name: create-user
actions.description: Add a new user to the Zendesk instance.

actions.name: delete-user
actions.description: Remove a user and associated records from the account.

actions.name: find-organization
actions.description: Search organizations by name, domain, external ID, or other criteria.

actions.name: find-tickets
actions.description: Search tickets by ID, field, or content.

actions.name: find-user
actions.description: Search users by email, name, role, or other criteria.

actions.name: find-agent
actions.description: Find an agent by email or name.

actions.name: find-latest-comment
actions.description: Find the latest comment on a ticket.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_ticket_in_view
triggers.description: Triggers when a new ticket is created in a view

triggers.name: new_ticket
triggers.description: Fires when a new ticket is created (optionally filtered by organization). Requires a Zendesk Trigger with Notify active webhook.

triggers.name: updated_ticket
triggers.description: Fires when an existing ticket is updated. Requires a Zendesk Trigger with Notify active webhook.

triggers.name: tag_added_to_ticket
triggers.description: Fires when a ticket update includes the specified tag. Requires a Zendesk Trigger with Notify active webhook.

triggers.name: new_organization
triggers.description: Fires when a new organization record is created. Uses Zendesk event webhook (no Trigger needed).

triggers.name: new_user
triggers.description: Fires when a new user is created. Uses Zendesk event webhook (no Trigger needed).

triggers.name: new_suspended_ticket
triggers.description: Fires when a ticket is suspended. Requires a Zendesk Trigger with Notify active webhook. Suspended tickets auto-delete after 14 days.

triggers.name: new_action_on_ticket
triggers.description: Fires when the specified ticket updates. Requires a Zendesk Trigger with Notify active webhook.

triggers.name: new_group
triggers.description: Fires when a new group is created.

triggers.name: tag_added_to_user
triggers.description: Triggers when one or more tags are added to a user.
